description: This file defines the WidgetTypeDao interface for managing widget types within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for CRUD operations, querying by various filters, and managing widget bundle associations.

classes.name: WidgetTypeDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to widget types, including CRUD, search, and association management.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a widget type details object for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a widget type by tenant ID and widget type UUID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Checks if a widget type exists for a given tenant ID and widget type UUID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves widget type info by tenant ID and widget type UUID.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetTypes
methods.description: Finds system widget types based on filter and pagination.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all tenant widget types for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetTypesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant widget types filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget types associated with a specific widget bundle.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesDetailsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type details associated with a specific widget bundle.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesInfosByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type info objects by widget bundle ID with filtering options.

methods.name: findWidgetFqnsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Retrieves fully qualified names of widgets in a bundle.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds a widget type by tenant ID and its fully qualified name.

methods.name: findDetailsByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds widget type details by tenant ID and FQN.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeIdsByTenantIdAndFqns
methods.description: Retrieves widget type IDs by tenant ID and list of FQNs.

methods.name: findWidgetsBundleWidgetsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget bundle widget associations by bundle ID.

methods.name: saveWidgetsBundleWidget
methods.description: Saves a widget bundle widget association.

methods.name: removeWidgetTypeFromWidgetsBundle
methods.description: Removes a widget type from a widget bundle.

methods.name: findAllWidgetTypesIds
methods.description: Retrieves all widget type IDs with pagination.
